svg.title: Centrair Terminal 1 — International flights
svg.desc: English schematic wayfinding map with floor levels, accessible toilets, elevators, escalators, stairs and locker information. Airside is at the top and north is to the right. Not to scale.

g.text: Public check-in lobby → security → boarding gates
Arrival corridor → baggage claim → public arrivals lobby
Use public elevators between 1F–4F. Follow your flight’s gate signs; the two flight areas are separate after security.
Schematic / not to scale • Airside at top / north to the right • Facilities are shown on their own floor.
